title: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
html:
See also: Touch of Death

Channel Divinity: Touch of Death is a Death Domain Cleric passive feature that allows the user to deal extra Necrotic damage with your melee attack.

Description

When hitting a creature with a melee attack,  Channel Divinity Charge can be used to deal extra 5 + 2 × (Cleric level)⁠⁠Necrotic damage.

Details

Cost:
 Channel Divinity Charge

Grants:

  •  Touch of Death

How to learn

Classes:

  • Class level 2: Death Domain

Notes

  • This can trigger off of any melee attack roll. This includes melee attack spells like  Inflict Wounds for example.
